notes: plugin: a permanent deviation (ADR 0004). Go plugins are shared objects built by the Go toolchain and loaded into a Go runtime that shares its type tables; Rust has neither. The surface exists and Open fails with "plugin: not implemented", as Go's stub does on platforms without plugin support

Open.note: fails with "plugin: not implemented", as Go's stub does where plugins are unsupported

Plugin.note: cannot be constructed: Open never succeeds

Plugin.Lookup.note: unreachable without a Plugin; returns the same error

Symbol.note: any boxed value; no plugin can supply one
